meta.title: How It Works — Acute Insight AI
meta.description: See how Acute Insight AI guides patients through AI-powered intake and gives providers instant clinical summaries, flags, and structured data.

hero.heading: From first symptom to clinical insight
hero.subheading: Acute Insight AI connects patients and providers through an intelligent intake layer — a conversational AI intake and real-time clinical analysis.

patientSection.heading: Start your intake in minutes
patientSection.subheading: No waiting rooms. No paper forms. Our AI guides you through a clinical intake that captures everything your provider needs.

steps.title: Start the conversation
steps.body: Tell Ace what's going on, in your own words — by voice or text. No paper forms, and no account needed to begin.

steps.title: Answer a few follow-ups
steps.body: Ace adapts to what you say and asks only what's relevant — chief complaint, duration, severity, medications, allergies, and history.

steps.title: Create your free account
steps.body: A quick sign-up saves your intake and lets you send it to your provider. Your health information stays private — visible only to you and your care team, and never sold or shared.

steps.title: Submit to your provider
steps.body: Your intake is instantly analyzed and delivered to your care team with an AI-generated summary and clinical flags highlighted.

providerSection.heading: Every patient, fully prepared
providerSection.subheading: Your dashboard surfaces what matters — AI summaries, clinical flags, and complete intake histories — so you can focus on care.

steps.title: Review your patient queue
steps.body: See all incoming intakes in a scrollable queue. Search by name, email, or chief complaint. Filter to flagged cases that need immediate attention.

steps.title: Read the AI summary
steps.body: Each intake includes a structured AI-generated clinical summary covering chief complaint, symptom timeline, severity, medications, and relevant history.

steps.title: Act on clinical flags
steps.body: Our model automatically surfaces high-priority signals — potential drug interactions, red-flag symptoms, and emergency indicators — so nothing slips through.

steps.title: Access the full transcript
steps.body: Drill into the complete conversation transcript alongside the patient's health profile, demographics, and prior intake history.

features.title: AI-powered analysis
features.body: Every intake is processed by a frontier large language model guided by a physician-written clinical protocol. Summaries are structured, consistent, and ready for provider review.

features.title: Emergency detection
features.body: Real-time keyword and pattern analysis flags emergency-level symptoms mid-intake. Patients are immediately shown a 911 prompt and can continue or exit safely.

features.title: Privacy first
features.body: Patient data is encrypted in transit with role-based access controls, and never sold or shared. Full HIPAA-ready infrastructure — encryption at rest, audit logging, BAAs — is on our checklist before general availability.

features.title: Talk or type
features.body: Patients answer by voice or text, whichever is easier — a natural conversation with Ace, not a form. Every intake produces the same structured clinical output.

features.title: Clinical flag extraction
features.body: High severity ratings, red-flag symptoms, and chronic patterns are automatically extracted and surfaced as actionable flags in the provider dashboard.

features.title: Full intake history
features.body: Patients and providers can access a chronological log of all past intakes, enabling longitudinal care tracking and trend identification over time.

ctaSection.heading: Ready to experience it?
ctaSection.subheading: Whether you're a patient looking for faster care or a provider seeking better intake data, Acute Insight AI is built for you.
